regeln: Maintain the ai-tools-explained identity: black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses within a painted open-world setting; introduce him at the opening and recur throughout.
Visuals must depict the specific narrated technical action or genuine interface; never replace actions with literal text labels, metaphors, or unrelated stock as visual substitutes.
Hook the viewer in the first 3 seconds by naming the specific AI tool and the practical, human-centric task it solves.
Use practical, task-oriented language; avoid jargon, benchmarks, or architecture names, and never narrate specific menu paths or button-clicking sequences.
Display the main subject prominently; avoid tiny images in empty vertical frames or filling gaps with background-only frames or unrelated stock.
Sync narration and subtitles precisely with motif changes; introduce every technical term or feature verbally before its visual appearance.
Integrate the mandatory 'like, share, save' call as a single, natural sentence that flows logically within the story context.
Never override source documentation or factual limits for storytelling; always identify tools briefly and show authentic interface views and source-supported examples.
Maintain pace appropriate to the format; do not impose long-video chapter pacing on Shorts or Shorts speed on long-form demonstrations.
Treat review scores and retention curves as provisional data; do not infer unobserved causes or ban styles based on single audience dips or image defects.
Use original urban painted open-world-game styling for fictional scenes; match narrated action and era without using copied game characters or anonymous period workers as founder likenesses.

Im gespeicherten Entwurf bleibt single forward pass als unbelegter Detailhinweis stehen.
Der Kritiker schlug eine neue Null-Halluzinations-Garantie und andere Tools vor; diese Vorschlaege sind keine Quellen.
Kein Video erzeugt, keine Video-Note und keine Telegram-Videozustellung.
